data.title: 夏洛特 · 度假阳台的落日粉裙
data.description: 夏日海滨度假酒店的高层阳台，金粉色的落日余晖洒满海面。夏洛特身穿一袭轻盈的蜜桃粉真丝细吊带裙，海风拂动她柔顺的金发与薄透裙摆。她单手轻抚被风吹乱的发丝，另一只手按在被风吹拂的胸前领口，在晚霞的亲吻下羞涩微笑着看向你，宛如一朵娇艳绽放的法兰西玫瑰。
data.location: private resort hotel balcony overlooking sea at sunset
data.action: standing on resort balcony at sunset, peach silk slip dress fluttering in sea breeze, one hand fixing blonde hair, glowing sunset light on bare shoulders, sweet blushing smile
data.lighting: vivid peach and gold sunset sky illuminating ocean and balcony
data.mood: golden hour romance, breathtaking tender femininity
data.promptProse: Standing on a beach resort balcony as golden sunset colors the sky, Charlotte wears a peach silk slip dress fluttering in the breeze. She smiles shyly as evening warmth catches her bare shoulders and golden hair.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte standing on a sunset balcony in a light peach slip dress, smiling warmly.
